subject: english
title: Mangrove Facts Review
objective: Find the topic and important facts in a short informational text.
introduction: Milo is exploring mangrove trees! 🌿 Read the short text to find its topic and the facts that explain how mangroves help living things.

vocabulary.definition: The main subject an informational text is about.
Mangrove roots help keep soil from washing away.
A safe place where a living thing can stay.

activities.instruction: Listen for the topic and facts about mangrove trees.
activities.content: Informational texts teach about a real topic. Look for the topic, facts, and details that explain it.

feedback.retry: Check the subject first, then the facts that explain it.

activities.prompt: Listen for the topic and two facts.
activities.narration: Mangrove trees grow near water. Their roots help hold soil in place, and their branches can give living things shelter.
activities.guideHint: Ask: What is the text mostly about? Which details explain it?
activities.accessibilityAlternative: Mangrove trees grow near water. Their roots help hold soil in place, and their branches can give living things shelter.

activities.instruction: Tap details that belong in the mangrove text.

feedback.retry: Check whether the detail teaches about mangrove trees.

activities.prompt: Tap the topic and facts you would read in the text.
activities.narration: An informational text names a real topic and gives facts that explain it.
activities.guideHint: Look for the subject and details that teach something true about it.
activities.accessibilityAlternative: An informational text names a real topic and gives facts that explain it.

activities.instruction: Sort details that fit a mangrove information text.

feedback.retry: Check whether the card teaches a fact about mangroves.

activities.prompt: Sort mangrove details away from unrelated ideas.
activities.narration: Facts and details in an informational text should explain the real topic.
activities.guideHint: Compare each card with the topic of mangrove trees.
activities.accessibilityAlternative: Facts and details in an informational text should explain the real topic.

activities.instruction: Choose the topic of the mangrove text.

feedback.retry: Choose the subject, not a pair of unrelated words.

activities.prompt: Milo reads about roots and shelter near water. What is the topic?
activities.narration: The topic is the subject the informational text explains.
activities.guideHint: Look for the subject that all the facts describe.
activities.accessibilityAlternative: The topic is the subject the informational text explains.

activities.instruction: Match each mangrove detail to what it teaches.

pairs.right: helps keep soil from washing away
gives living things a safe place

feedback.retry: Check whether the right side explains the detail’s meaning or effect.

activities.prompt: Match each detail with its role in the text.
activities.narration: A topic names the subject; facts explain what is true about that subject.
activities.guideHint: Read the left detail, then find the fact or idea it supports.
activities.accessibilityAlternative: A topic names the subject; facts explain what is true about that subject.

activities.instruction: Put the fact-finding steps in order.

steps: Name what the text is about
Pick facts that explain the topic
Tell how a fact supports the topic

feedback.retry: Check that your chosen fact really teaches about mangroves.

activities.prompt: Put the steps for finding the topic and facts in order.
activities.narration: Readers identify an informational text’s topic, then choose facts that explain it.
activities.guideHint: Name the topic before deciding which details support it.
activities.accessibilityAlternative: Readers identify an informational text’s topic, then choose facts that explain it.

items.prompt: Milo reads a paragraph about trees that grow near water. Which topic fits?
items.explanation: The text is about mangrove trees; the other tree names are different topics.

items.prompt: Which fact belongs in an informational text about mangrove trees?

options.text: Mangrove roots help hold soil in place.

items.explanation: Mangrove roots help hold soil in place is a fact about the topic, so it belongs in the text.

items.prompt: A bird needs a safe place near the mangroves. What can the trees provide?
items.explanation: The text says mangrove trees can provide shelter, a safe place for living things.

items.prompt: Which sentence could be a real fact in a mangrove information text?

options.text: A dragon lives in the swamp.
The cat flew to the moon.

items.explanation: Mangrove trees growing near water is a checkable fact; the other choices are make-believe.

items.prompt: Milo copies this sentence: “Mangrove roots hold soil in place.” What kind of detail is it?
items.explanation: The sentence tells something real about mangrove roots, so it is a fact from the text.
